description: The Knowasiak people map: the places with the most members or businesses, at city level (or a country, for members without a city), optionally only those in one industry or here for one reason, with how many each industry and reason has. Members appear at their city, never an exact position; members who hid themselves are not counted.

here_for.description: Only members here for this: learn (Here to learn), connect (Open to meeting people), share (Sharing what they build), market (Following their industry), customers (Looking for customers).
